name: Robô
notes: Roller: a round robot vacuum. idle blinks its status LED; move-* spins the side brush at its front-left foot (4 frames). curl-left is its spin: turning in place from facing you to facing left (3 frames, once; reverse it to turn back). happy-down shows a heart on the visor; sleep-down closes its eyes and the LED goes off, settling a pixel. Extra clips for the runtime: bump-left (4 frames, once: it hits something on its left, the bumper gives, it backs off a pixel and stops; play it when a move is blocked) and dock-down (4 frames, loops: the visor shows a charging bar filling; play it while it rests near its owner or a desk).
